title: Size Randomizer
description: The size randomzer, randomizes the player size with their health and attack value plus it randomizes the mob size!
body:
The size randomizer changes the player and mob size randomly between 0.01x and 10x! Some sizes are more common but more op sizes are less common but still pretty obtainable. Smaller players will get some debuffs but bigger players will get buffs!

**THE MOD REQUIRES 3.8.3 PEHKUI**

**DISCLAIMER:
Also for the mod to work for the first time in the world you need to /kill**


Size player percentages: (can be changed in the config file)
- 1% for 0.01x,
- 30% - 0.02x - 0.89x,
- 30% 0.9x - 1.19x,
- 20% - 1.2x - 5.99x,
- 18% - 5x - 9.99x,
- 0.9% - 10x,
- 0.1% - 30x.
